name: USGS (U.S. Geological Survey) website and information products
goodFor: Geologic, water, hazard and mapping explainers, data and publications for geology and physical geography.

evidence.quote: USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain .
While the content of most USGS websites is in the U.S. Public Domain, not all information, illustrations, or photographs on our site are.
Some non-USGS photographs, images, and/or graphics that appear on USGS websites are used by the USGS with permission from the copyright holder
For commercial use of that multimedia, permission may be required.
This identifier is trademarked and must be used in accordance with the rules outlined in the Visual Identity System.

notes: Checked against USGS's Copyrights and Credits page (the Acknowledging or Crediting USGS page says most USGS information is in the public domain and may be used without restriction, with credit asked for). USGS-authored material is public domain, but the pages also carry non-USGS photographs, images and graphics used with the owner's permission, which are only generally marked as copyrighted, and people who appear in USGS multimedia may have publicity rights that matter for commercial use. The USGS visual identifier is a trademark. Third-party and unmarked items can't be separated from USGS-authored ones without looking at each item, so it is link only. Publications on pubs.usgs.gov and the earthquake site were not read. The site's link-policy page covers only USGS's own links to other sites and sets no condition on linking to USGS. See also us-government. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
